title: Non-blocking finding from PR #323's review (backend-day-trader-timeframe-mode-history-followups)
description: Non-blocking finding recorded by pr-reviewer while accepting PR #323, which closed the three non-blocking findings from PR #316's review (a new discriminating test class for the `_already_clean` escape hatches in `backend/tests/unit/signals/test_engine.py`, a decision documenting existing coverage for the mocked-IBKR end-to-end chaining test, and a whitespace fix in `backend/app/data/ibkr_provider.py`). None of this blocked the accept -- the two new tests were independently re-verified as genuinely discriminating (reproduced by temporarily making both `_daily_ohlcv_already_clean`/`_short_term_ohlcv_already_clean` unconditional no-ops in `app/signals/engine.py`'s `analyse()` and confirming both new tests then fail, then reverting), the 'already covered' claim for the mocked-IBKR chaining test was independently re-verified by reading `app/api/routers/stocks.py`'s `_get_day_trader_indicator_history` and `app/api/day_trader_signal.py`'s `fetch_day_trader_history_legs` to confirm the real call chain (`get_intraday_history_bars_for_triple` -> `analyse_history_day_trader`) and by reading `test_stocks_indicator_history.py::TestDayTraderMode::test_fully_intraday_triple_replays_a_real_walk_forward_history`'s assertions (discriminating: an earlier replay point must differ from the latest one, not the same snapshot repeated), and the style nit was confirmed to be a pure whitespace-only change.

checklist.step: The malformed daily+weekly OHLCV fixture construction (20 rising closes + 5-day selloff + one rally bar, paired with a 40-week 5%/week-growth weekly series) is now duplicated inline in at least three places in `backend/tests/unit/signals/test_engine.py`: `TestAnalyseEndToEnd.test_end_to_end_buy_after_pullback_and_trigger`, `TestAnalyseEndToEnd.test_malformed_latest_bar_is_excluded_and_does_not_change_signal`, and this PR's new `TestAlreadyCleanEscapeHatchesGenuinelySkipCleaning._malformed_daily_and_weekly`. Separately, the malformed (`NaN` open/high/low/close, populated volume) single-row fixture is duplicated within this PR's own new class -- once inside `_malformed_daily_and_weekly` and once directly inside `test_short_term_ohlcv_already_clean_true_leaves_the_malformed_latest_bar_in_place`. Not a correctness issue and not introduced as a net-new pattern by this PR (the daily/weekly duplication predates it), but worth extracting a shared module-level helper (or two: one for the BUY-fixture daily+weekly pair, one for the single malformed NaN row) that all of these call sites reuse, so a future change to the fixture shape doesn't need to be applied by hand in 3+ places.

decisions.decision: Extracted two module-level helper functions in `backend/tests/unit/signals/test_engine.py`, alongside the existing `_daily_ohlcv`/`_weekly_ohlcv`/`_nan_tolerant_equal` module-level helpers: `_buy_fixture_daily_and_weekly()` (the 20-rising-close + 5-day-selloff + rally-bar daily OHLCV, paired with the 40-week 5%/week-growth BULLISH weekly OHLCV) and `_malformed_nan_row(volume=500_000)` (the single NaN-open/high/low/close, populated-volume bar). Rewired all identified duplication sites to call these instead of constructing the fixtures inline: `TestAnalyseEndToEnd.test_end_to_end_buy_after_pullback_and_trigger` and `.test_malformed_latest_bar_is_excluded_and_does_not_change_signal` now call `_buy_fixture_daily_and_weekly()`; `TestAlreadyCleanEscapeHatchesGenuinelySkipCleaning._malformed_daily_and_weekly` now composes both helpers via `pd.concat`; and the three remaining single-NaN-row call sites (`test_malformed_latest_bar_is_excluded_and_does_not_change_signal`, `TestAnalyseShortTermOhlcvGenericTrigger.test_short_term_ohlcv_is_cleaned_of_malformed_bars`, and `TestAlreadyCleanEscapeHatchesGenuinelySkipCleaning.test_short_term_ohlcv_already_clean_true_leaves_the_malformed_latest_bar_in_place`) now call `_malformed_nan_row()`.
decisions.rationale: Two separate helpers (rather than one combined one) because the daily+weekly BUY pair and the single malformed row are reused independently -- `test_end_to_end_buy_after_pullback_and_trigger` needs only the former (no malformed row at all), while the short-term-OHLCV call sites need only the latter (composed with a *different* base series, `_short_term_ohlcv_that_fires_a_bullish_trigger()`, not the daily+weekly pair). A single fused 'BUY-fixture-plus-malformed-row' helper would have forced an awkward parameter to opt out of the malformed row for the one call site that doesn't want it. Module-level (not class-level) placement mirrors the file's existing `_daily_ohlcv`/`_weekly_ohlcv`/`_nan_tolerant_equal` helpers immediately above, and lets `TestAlreadyCleanEscapeHatchesGenuinelySkipCleaning` (a different test class than `TestAnalyseEndToEnd`) reuse `_buy_fixture_daily_and_weekly()` without an awkward cross-class static-method reference, matching the existing convention used elsewhere in the file for cross-class reuse of `TestAnalyseShortTermOhlcvGenericTrigger`'s own static methods (which stayed class-scoped since only two other classes needed them and both already import the class). Pure refactor, zero test-behavior change: verified by running `pytest tests/unit/signals/test_engine.py` (98 passed, matching the pre-refactor count) and the full backend suite (`pytest --cov=app`: 1402 passed, 100% line/branch coverage, matching PR #323's own review notes) both before and after -- same assertions, same pass/fail outcomes, only the fixture-construction code moved.

review.notes: Pure test-hygiene refactor, verified end to end. Diffed backend/tests/unit/signals/test_engine.py line-by-line: both extracted helpers (`_buy_fixture_daily_and_weekly()`, `_malformed_nan_row(volume=500_000)`) are byte-for-byte identical to what was previously inline at each of the 5 rewired call sites (TestAnalyseEndToEnd.test_end_to_end_buy_after_pullback_and_trigger, .test_malformed_latest_bar_is_excluded_and_does_not_change_signal, TestAnalyseShortTermOhlcvGenericTrigger.test_short_term_ohlcv_is_cleaned_of_malformed_bars, TestAlreadyCleanEscapeHatchesGenuinelySkipCleaning._malformed_daily_and_weekly and .test_short_term_ohlcv_already_clean_true_leaves_the_malformed_latest_bar_in_place) -- no assertion, fixture shape, or default-argument value changed. Independently re-ran: `pytest tests/unit/signals/test_engine.py -q` -> 98 passed (matches claimed pre/post-refactor count); full backend suite `pytest --cov=app --cov-report=term-missing --cov-fail-under=90` -> 1402 passed, 100% line/branch coverage; `ruff check .` clean; `mypy` clean (67 source files); `python scripts/check_profit_target_wording.py` clean; `python scripts/validate_tasks.py` -> 317 task files, no violations. Frontend untouched by this PR (no files under frontend/ in the diff) -- last known state clean, not re-run. No production signal/portfolio code touched (only the test file and task-board bookkeeping), so verify-elder-signal's checklist has nothing to check here beyond confirming that non-touch. No API/schema change, no frontend component, so the OpenAPI-snapshot check, browser walkthrough, and e2e suite (steps 8/9/9a) don't apply -- explicitly skipped as this PR has no UI surface. A separate code-review skill pass (medium effort, run independently) also returned zero findings, corroborating the manual line-by-line diff. No blocking or non-blocking findings; no follow-up task created.

pr_decision.notes: Independently diffed backend/tests/unit/signals/test_engine.py against origin/main and confirmed both extracted helpers (_buy_fixture_daily_and_weekly, _malformed_nan_row) are byte-for-byte identical to the removed inline code at all 5 rewired call sites -- pure refactor, no behavior change. Re-ran tests/unit/signals/test_engine.py myself (98 passed) and the full backend suite (pytest --cov=app --cov-fail-under=90: 1402 passed, 100% line/branch coverage), plus ruff/mypy (clean) and validate_tasks.py (317 files, no violations) -- all matching pr-reviewer's reported numbers. docs/tasks/index.json's state/path mirror for this task is consistent with the done move.
